Commentary.Commentary: After losing quick wickets at the start, Pakistan got things together. Bismah Maroof and Nida Dar both stroked their way to fifties, stitching a 93-run stand. But there were no other contributions from the rest. What will hurt them more is that because of their running, they were handed a 10 run penalty. All said and done, if they bowl well they can give India a run for their money.

Good comeback from India towards the end. They started off well picking up 3 early wickets. Then due to poor fielding and catching they let the game get away from them. later on the girls broke the partnership and tightened things towards the end picking up few wickets. Other than the fielding they did well to restrict the Pakistan women who were going well in the middle overs.

Outside off, Diana cuts it towards point. Raj gets to the ball and throws it to the keeper. They complete the run but the umpire cancels the run yet again. Guess what, another 5-run penalty for them Which means India will get a head start of 10 runs. After 20 overs, Pakistan end with 133/7.
Diana Baig to face the last ball.
OUT! Another one this over and another stumping. Spins away from Mir who is way out of her crease. Taniya has all the time to take the bails off.
Outside off again, Mir fails to put bat to ball. Good over so far.
Sana Mir makes her way in.
OUT! STUMPED! Outside off, Riaz comes forward and looks to slap this but cannot get bat to ball. The keeper takes off the bails in a flash.
FOUR! The best shot of the night. Full on middle, Riaz gets to the ball and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Outside off, cut to point.
Punched off the back foot by Khan.
Outside off, Khan goes close to the ball and then leaves it. Wanted the wide but nothing from the umpire.
Khan has played it to the point region.
Nahida Khan is in.
OUT! Second of the over! Short ball outside off, Dar cuts it straight to Kaur at cover-point. Easy catch.
SIX! Another tossed up ball on middle, Dar lofts it over mid-wicket. Smriti at cow corner takes the catch but steps on the ropes back. Maximum to bring up her fifty!
Aliya Riaz walks out to bat.
OUT! Finally a catch from the Indians. Loopy ball on off, Maroof looks to go big. Does not get enough distance and Veda at long on makes no mistake.
FOUR! Off spinner on leg, Dar adjust well and pulls it behind square for a boundary.
Sharma goes short again, Maroof pulls it through mid-wicket. They cross.
Short, pulled to cow corner for another one.
Full on middle, paddle behind the keeper to get to the other end.
Short and down leg, pulled fine to fine leg for a run.

Outside off, cut towards point for one. Now then, the players have been given a 5-run penalty for running between the wickets. These 5 runs will be added to the Indian total. The run for this ball too is not considered.
Deepti Sharma to bowl out.
FOUR! Clean! Dances down the track and lofts this over mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep hares to her right but cannot get to the ball. Boundary.
Maroof drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for one more.
FIFTY for Maroof! Her seventh in international T20 cricket. Drops this ball to the off side and gets to the other end.
Another good shot for just one. Comes down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket for a run.
Arm ball outside off, Maroof reverse sweeps it to third man for just one.
Maroof has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. She is bringing out everything she has. Length on middle, Maroof paddles it over the keeper's head. No protection there and another boundary to her name.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off, Maroof shimmies off and at the last moment guides it through backward point for a good looking boundary.
Slower ball down leg, Dar misses the swipe. The ball hits her pads and rolls to the on side. They steal a leg bye.
On a good length around off, Maroof lofts it to cow corner for a run.
Length outside off, Maroof can't get it past point. Dot ball.
Arundhati Reddy to finish her spell.
Change.
Darts this outside off, Dar reaches for it but can't get bat to ball. Dot to end but still 9 from it.
Arm ball outside off, slogged to cow corner for one.
Off spinner on off, comes into Dar who cuts it to the off side to rotate strike.
In the gaps again. Won't go all the way but they pick up three. Gets to the ball and drives this through covers.
FOUR! Nicely done. Outside off, Maroof uses her feet and lofts it over covers. No fielder in the deep and she picks up a boundary for that.
Driven through the covers by Maroof.
Halt in play! Looks like Maroof has got some cramps and is receiving treatment for the physios. She is good to go now. Also, Dayalan Hemalatha will bowl now.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Rocks back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.

Another chance missed. What are India doing? On middle, Maroof looks to turn it away but gets a top edge towards mid on. Kaur and Poonam looks to take it but either gets close to the ball. Bowler's catch that. One run picked.
Lovely. In the gap through mid-wicket. Enough time to collect another couple.
Inside-out. Gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it over mid off. They pick up two and brings up the 50-run stand between them.
Full on middle, hit towards mid on for one.
Poonam Yadav in for her third over.
Dar punches that ball through the offside. They pick up a single.
Played to mid-wicket region by Maroof. The players have run through for a single.

DROPPED! 3rd one now in this innings. How costly will this prove? Flighted ball on off, Dar swipes but gets a top edge towards mid-wicket. Poonam runs backwards and gets under the ball but cannot hold onto it.
Plays this with the spin with soft hands. Two is the call but will settle for a run.
Outside off, Dar gets it off the toe end over mid off for just one.
Played through mid-wicket by Maroof. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! HUGE! Loopy ball on off, Dar gets to the pitch of the ball and with all her might slogs this over mid-wicket for half a dozen.
Driven towards the mid off region. One run added to the total as Veda misfields.
On off, swept towards square leg. Another fumble and Pakistan take a run.
On off, Dar gets behind the ball and gives it for the cover fielder to collect.
Dar covers her stumps and pushes this to the off side.
Outside off, cut past point for one.
Full on middle, Dar slogs this over mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep who keeps it to two.

DROPPED AND FOUR! The fielding has been good but not the catching. Tossed up ball around off, Dar lofts it towards long off. It does not go all the way. Krishnamurthy settles under it but the ball goes through her hands and into the ropes.
Played through mid-wicket by Maroof. One run added to the total.
Nicely done. Tickles this fine towards backward square leg for a brace.
Dar plays a sweep shot. One run added to the total.
Dar has punched the ball off the back foot.
Radha Yadav into the attack.
Long appeal but nothing from the umpire. Tossed up ball on leg, Maroof brings out the broom but cannot make contact. The players appeal but perhaps that was pitching outside leg.
Dar has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
Picks up the length early and reverse sweeps it to backward point for one.
In the air... just over Sharma. On middle, Dar comes down the track and lofts it just over the bowler. Deepti jumps but cannot get her hand to it. They cross.
Loopy ball on off, Maroof uses her feet and drives it to extra cover. Just one.
Tossed up ball on leg, turned with the spin. They run the first one hard and think about the second but abort it wisely.
Deepti Sharma to bowl her second over.
Short ball outside off, pulled over mid-wicket for just one.
Dar gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
FOUR! Nice! Gets low to this loopy ball and sweeps it over square leg for a boundary.
BM has played the square drive. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Maroof looks to guide it but cannot make contact.
Slower ball outside off, Maroof paddle it to fine leg. Enough for her to come back for the second.
FOUR! Slap and an effective one. Full and outside off, Dar reaches for it, gets low and slaps it through point. The ball runs to the fence.
Good fielding off her own bowling. On a good length on leg, Maroof tucks it away and changes ends. Reddy runs towards the ball and keeps it to one.
Good line, closer to the off pole. Maroof drives it to covers.
Full on middle and leg, Maroof gets it off the inner half through square leg. The fielder in the deep is too far which enables the players to pick two.
Finds the gap. Creams it through covers for a single.
Length ball around off, played with a straight bat by Dar.
One hand sweep. On middle and off, swept to square leg.
Full on middle and leg, Dar on-drives it towards mid on and gives the strike to her partner.
On off, driven to covers.
Pushed to the cover region by Maroof. They pick up a single.
Nida Dar comes out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. A big mix up and Pakistan lose another wicket. Maroof drives this to covers. Khan at the other end is off her crease. She is then sent back half way. Radha at point collects, gives it to the bowler who completes the formalities.
Googly to start with. maroof is beaten as she plays across the wrong line.
Poonam Yadav to have a go.
FOUR! Deft! Lovely from Khan. Waits for the ball and plays it late through the short third man region for a boundary.
Good running. Plays this with soft hands towards the off side and quickly gets to the other end.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but Maroof still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Full and down leg, Javeria swipes it fine through fine leg and gets a boundary to her name. Despite losing wickets, Pakistan are aggressive in their play.
outside off, cut to point.
Maroof has pushed it to the cover region.
Dayalan Hemalatha to roll her arm.

NOT OUT! India lose their review. Loopy ball on off, Khan looks to flick the ball but misses. It goes off something and the keeper takes the catch. India appeal but the umpire stays put. India opt for the review. Nothing on Snicko and the skipper survives.
Javeria tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Pushed to the cover region by BM. One run added to the total.
Full on leg, swept to square leg.
JK has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Maroof plays the square cut. One run added to the total.
Arm ball on off, soft outside edge towards the slip cordon.
Khan rocks back and cuts it through backward point. They manage to come back for the second.
Outside off, Khan goes for the cut but can't get behind it.
FOUR! Lovely! Full and on middle, Khan slogs over mid-wicket with a full swipe. The fielder hares behind it but comes second best.

OUT! Excellent piece of fielding from Jemimah Rodrigues. On off, Sohail taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. Jemimah there collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. She hits the target and Sohail is no where. Walks. Second blow for Pakistan.
US was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Sohail has played it to the point region.
Single to end the over. Full and outside off, carved behind point for a single.
Around off, sliced over backward point. Just a run.
FOUR! Great shot. Full and on middle and leg, Javeria slogs it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Played to the point region by Khan.
Length on off, Khan gets a leading edge towards covers which falls short of the fielders.
DROPPED! She just saved a boundary in the deep and now puts down a sitter, Mandhana. Fuller length outside off, Khan swings it towards mid on. Smriti settles under it but cannot hold onto it.
Another great stop. Outside off, Javeria cuts it past point. Mandhana in the deep dives and keeps it to two.
Pushed to the cover region by Sohail.
Excellent stop. Hemlata at mid-wicket. Khan swings it from outside off towards mid-wicket. Hemlata dives to her right and keeps it to one.
Javeria manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Outside off, play and miss from Khan.
Wide! Too wide outside off, Khan leaves it alone and a wide signaled by the umpire.
Arm ball on off, Javeria plays it to the off side.

OUT! Maiden wicket for Reddy! Brilliant bowling. Pakistan lose their first wicket in the first over itself. What a start for India. Outside off, Ayesha looks to play it late but gives it straight to Veda at first slip. She dives to her right and takes a very good catch.
Make it 5. Length, moving away from Ayesha who swings and misses.
Comes down the track and drives it superbly but can't get it past the mid off fielder. 4 dots in a row.
Perfect. On a good length outside off, Ayesha drives but connects with thin air.
Better from Reddy. In line of the stumps, driven to covers.
Length ball outside off, Ayesha looks to cut it but misses it completely.
The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Ayesha Zafar and the skipper Javeria Khan walk out to take strike. For India,  Arundhati Reddy will open the bowling.
Team news - India remain unchanged. Pakistan drop Nashra Sandhu for Diana Baig.
TOSS - India have won the toss and have opted to bowl.

Hello and welcome to match 5 of the WWT20. India and Pakistan go head-to-head and will want to grab eye balls. Pakistan in search of their first win after a dubbing in their previous game. On the other hand, India will look to continue their impressive run and climb top of the table. All to play for here and the crowds have come out in good numbers. Toss and teams news in some time.
